subject.title: [Bug]: ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME} is not process when installing a skill

question: Should OpenClaw expand `$VAR`/`${VAR}` inside shared user/workspace path resolvers, or should env interpolation stay limited to config-load/dotenv semantics?
rationale: Both choices affect shipped path/config behavior, and AGENTS.md treats config/env surfaces as compatibility-sensitive rather than an automatic bugfix lane.

options.title: Adopt resolver expansion with tests
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR with resolver-level expansion plus regression coverage for configured workspaces and ClawHub skill install targets.

options.title: Keep interpolation at config load only
options.body: Document paths as config-substituted values and fix the specific install path flow without adding generic `$VAR` expansion to all user paths.

options.title: Defer to dotenv canonical issue
options.body: Keep this issue linked while #38259 decides the broader dotenv/env-expansion contract before changing path behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt resolver expansion with tests
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR with resolver-level expansion plus regression coverage for configured workspaces and ClawHub skill install targets.
